scope: Frozen AIRL map; random G1, optimizer, EMA; each promoted budget begins at exposure zero

dataset.training: src/waymo_data/full/training_map2_sd_files.pkl; seeded fixed full order repeated each epoch; native final partial batches retained
dataset.calibration: 8192 fixed TRAIN-only scenes, calibration selection held fixed across arms
dataset.full_audit: all50000 physical scenario_dreamer_val scenes; matched reference; require-full-set=true

seed_roles.TRAIN4817: Adaptive screening/medium/long discovery. Reused validation selection; not held-out confirmation.
seed_roles.TRAIN5817: Independent frozen-recipe long confirmation, same actual exposure and fresh G1/optimizer/EMA.
seed_roles.GEN2817_GEN3817: Repeated generation draws inside each TRAIN seed; mean before equal-weight TRAIN aggregate. Never counted as TRAIN N4.
seed_roles.screen_GEN: GEN2817 only; medium/final/full50k use both GEN seeds.

primary_criterion: Arithmetic mean of seven ratios of equal-TRAIN-weighted candidate native metric means to same-exposure control metric means (GEN averaged inside TRAIN). Lower R is better.

gates.final: Pooled and every TRAIN seed must satisfy all gates; missing scope/counts/GEN cannot rank.

promotion.screen: Up to two eligible novel arms ranked R,R_attr,name; eligible combo_reference fills missing novel slots. If no eligible candidate, explore up to two best R arms and mark exploratory.
promotion.medium: Minimum R eligible challenger; if none pass gate, freeze lowest R as exploratory and do not claim improvement yet.
promotion.final: Control and frozen challenger only; require exactly8 endpoint cells =2arms x2TRAIN x2GEN and identical physical cohort/source/actual exposure. No reselect using independent5817. Select challenger only if final pooledR<1 and pooled/perTRAINgates.
promotion.full50k: Same4817 checkpoints,2arms x2GEN; audit scope only, no reselect and no additional TRAIN N.

deadline_rule: At medium completion, measure seconds/update of actual full fit, estimate two fresh TRAIN pairs, add15% margin+20min full50000; select highest shared final budget that fits01:35UTC. If no option fits, attempt minimum and explicitly mark deadline_risk. No fake completion after cutoff.
faults: Durable stage execution exactargv/design/external/source SHA plus terminalDONE and protocol/summary/report/config/initialization SHA. Skip only verified success; partial/failed outputs require manual checkpoint recovery, never silent replay.
interpretation_limits: Screen .80epoch ranking can differ from8.50-12.75epoch from-scratch ranking.
TwoTRAIN final gives limited uncertainty precision, not proof of optimum.
Same seed does not force identical training noise draws across different architecture constructor RNG consumption or different batches.
Native map encoder permanently frozen, map weights never used as full training resume; G1fresh EMA history.
FixedGTego pose/heading/shape/type are imposed inputs; corresponding zero L1/typeacc1 cannot be claimed as generated ego quality.
GT non-ego type is training target only; generation uses model type feedback, no non-egoGTtype conditioning.
speed/length/width tolerances permit up to15% regression individually, so report each actual ratio explicitly.
128epoch ultimate optimum remains unproven; native epoch-based128epoch cosine schedule is unchanged by quick search.
